art_direction.silhouette_criteria: Full-scale 18m x 22m cast-iron railway archival wall with deep structural bays, projecting brass rail beams, visible notched locking bars, overhead pulley sheaves, taut steel counterweight cables, angled transfer chutes, and open rooftop conservatory arches above.
art_direction.material_response_criteria: Photographic PBR response at close and mid camera distances: oxblood-brown archival lacquer with fine edge wear (roughness 0.28-0.55), fine woven luggage canvas with controlled fibre scale (roughness 0.72-0.88), muted crimson baize interior lining (roughness 0.80-0.92), and machined tarnished brass hardware (metalness 0.88, roughness 0.25-0.42).
art_direction.scene_density_criteria: High architectural legibility: every climbable drawer front, top rim, load cage, and ledge is visually distinct from background archival bays; zero visual clutter hiding footholds or notch indicators.
art_direction.signature_motion_criteria: 1) Opening burst drawer beneath player -> rolling brass parcel tips receiving tray -> coupled counterweight hauls catching drawer outward. 2) Coupled counterweight lift/drawer motion driven by authoritative mass balance and tensioned cables. 3) Chute payload dispatch with visible transit and arrival impulse. 4) Final #309 rooftop drawer opening from inside to flood the hall with warm golden garden daylight.

coupled_proof.framing: Fits stage2 lift, counterweight drawer and player head; camera offset X2.3,Y1.2 and distance computed from current vertical span.
